messages:
maria: Heads-up — security scanner flagged a public gist containing a Kubernetes serviceaccount token. It's for staging/ingress-controller-sa. I redacted the gist and opened INC-2309. Need token revocation + rotation coordination ASAP.

devsec-bot: Incident INC-2309 created by maria. Severity: medium-high. PagerDuty: #oncall-eng. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2309

alex: thanks for the heads up. do we know where the token was used (ci, daemonset, external service)?

maria: raw token in gist, but grep of repos shows a GH Actions workflow in repo deploy-staging referencing a secret named STAGING_INGRESS_TOKEN. unclear if that env var stored in Vault or GH secrets.

sam: can you paste the gist snippet (redacted) and the k8s secret name? i'll start the isolation steps.

maria: snippet: "token: "[REDACTED-TOKEN]"". On cluster it's mounted as secret ingress-controller-sa-token (namespace staging). Pod using it: ingress-controller-5c9d7bd.

jen: i'll take Vault/GH side. steps i'm planning: 1) check if STAGING_INGRESS_TOKEN exists in Vault or GH secrets 2) if in Vault, create new version/kv put + rewrap with KMS 3) if GH, rotate secret and update workflows. Tag me when you rotate k8s token so i can update references.

ops-bot: @oncall-eng alerted. Runbook: revoke SA token -> create new SA token -> update deployments -> rotate external secrets -> audit logs collection.

dan: quick questions: is this a projected token (automount) or a service account token secret? also want to tighten RBAC for that SA while rotating.

maria: it's the classic token secret (kubernetes.io/service-account-token). automountServiceAccountToken is not set on pods. we should audit other pods in staging for same SA.

sam: i'll do immediate mitigation on cluster. plan: 1) cordon canary? no need. 2) create new serviceaccount ingress-controller-sa-rotated 3) bind same ClusterRoleBinding temporarily 4) create token and patch deployment to use new SA 5) delete old token secret. commands i'll run: ```bash
# create new sa
kubectl -n staging create sa ingress-controller-sa-rotated
# copy rolebindings
kubectl -n staging get clusterrolebinding ingress-controller-binding -o yaml | sed 's/ingress-controller-sa/ingress-controller-sa-rotated/g' | kubectl apply -f -
# create token
kubectl -n staging create token ingress-controller-sa-rotated --duration=8760h > new_token.txt
# patch deployment
kubectl -n staging patch deploy ingress-controller -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"serviceAccountName": "ingress-controller-sa-rotated"}}}}'
# remove old secret
kubectl -n staging delete secret ingress-controller-sa-token || true
```

alex: good. also please enable audit search for that token string across logs (apiserver audit + kubelet logs + any ingress logs). we need to enumerate IPs that pulled the gist. jen, can you check GH actions audit and Vault access time windows?

jen: on it. vault audit logs show no reads of kv/staging/ingress-token in last 30d. GH audit shows a secrets.get for deploy-staging 2 days ago from user deploy-bot. i'll rotate GH secret anyway. preparing new value once sam generates cluster token. also will KMS-rewrap the new secret to maintain transit key rotation: ```bash
# example vault rewrap step (transit)
vault write sys/transit/rewrap name=ingress-enc ciphertext=<old> # for reference
vault kv put secret/staging/ingress-token token=<new_token> # KMS/HSM backed depending on mount
```

maria: also recommend we set automountServiceAccountToken: false on pods that don't need it and add a podsecurity policy/psa to block broad SA use. dan, can you own an RBAC hardening PR?

dan: I will. I'll open a PR to default automountServiceAccountToken: false in our kustomize overlays and create an admission policy to reject pods mounting cluster-wide SAs. ETA 4 hrs for PR + 1hr for rollout after review.

sam: rotation started — created ingress-controller-sa-rotated and patched deployment. new token saved to secrets manager path secret/staging/ingress-token-temp (marked rotating). old secret removed. patch rolled with zero-downtime.

ops-bot: Noted: Deployment patch applied by sam at 1768459401. Health checks green.

jen: GH secret rotated and workflow updated to use new secret (deploy-staging repo). Vault updated and KMS rewrap queued; will confirm wrap checksum.

alex: good containment. next steps: 1) scope blast radius: list other clusters/Namespaces using that SA 2) run grep across codebase for the token to ensure no other leaks 3) follow-up postmortem w/ timeline and controls. who will own each?

maria: i'll own blast radius scan and postmortem. jen owns secrets rewrap and audit证明 (logs). sam confirmed cluster remediation. dan owns RBAC hardening PR. alex — can you review postmortem draft when ready?

alex: yep. please add link to all commands run in the ticket. also add a short automated test to GH actions to fail if any hard-coded tokens are committed.

sam: quick FYI — found one other repo with a sandbox script with the token in history (not active). opened PR to scrub history and rotate any derived secrets.

maria: thanks everyone. closing thread for live updates; I'll post a short summary in INC-2309 and ping legal if needed. :thumbsup:
